tray.hotkey_failed: The global hotkey could not be registered: {0}
fav.empty_tip: Click to choose a file, script or folder (or drop a file onto the button).

settings.title: Radial Wheel settings
layout.hint: Drag the rows to change the sector positions (the top row is at 12:00, then clockwise).
icons.hint: Choose a custom icon (.png, .svg, .ico) for each sector.
func.lang_note: The language is applied after restarting the application.
hk.mouse_warn: The chosen mouse button is captured by this application and will not work in other programs.
sound.enable: Sound effect when moving across sectors
reset.text: Restores all settings (paths, programs, themes, hotkeys) to factory defaults.
reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to restore the factory settings?
page.folders_hint: Each slot is a tile in the “Directories and Folders” panel and can hold a folder, a program or a file. Add, remove and reorder slots. Variables such as %USERPROFILE% are supported.
page.programs_hint: Each slot is a tile in the “Programs and Applications” panel (program, file or folder). An empty path on a built-in slot = the default program.
page.favorites_hint: Files, scripts or folders for the “Favorites and Quick Access” panel. Add, remove and reorder slots.
page.shortcuts_hint: Two rows of up to 3 combinations. Format: Ctrl+C, Shift+Win+S, Alt+Left, Ctrl+Shift+Esc … Empty = no combination. Invalid ones turn red and are not saved.
slot.name: Name
slot.hint_empty: Empty slot: clicking it in the panel lets you choose a file/folder.
grid.per_row: Fixed number of tiles per row
grid.hint: Visual grid configurator: choose a panel, a layout mode and sizes. The preview shows how the panel will look. Sizes are at 100 % scale; 0 = automatic.
update.hint: Update the tool from a .zip archive with a new version (same structure as the installation archive). Your settings and configuration are kept.
update.drop:
Drop the .zip archive here
or click to choose it
update.confirm_same: Note: the archive version is not newer than the current one.
update.bad_zip: This archive does not look like a valid Radial Wheel archive (app/main.py is missing).
update.not_zip: The file is not a valid .zip archive.
update.unsupported: Updating is not supported for the compiled (.exe) build. Use the installer.
update.deps: If the new version needs new libraries, run install.bat from the archive.
